# ESR Law Group

> Chicago-based medical malpractice and personal injury law firm specializing in complex litigation and estate matters.

ESR Law Group is a legal practice founded by attorney Edward S. Rueda, serving clients in Chicago and the surrounding Illinois region. The firm focuses on medical malpractice, personal injury claims, probate litigation, and estate planning with particular expertise in benzodiazepine-related cases and will contests.
